title: Goodwill and Bonus Miles in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program
content:
**Goodwill miles.** Goodwill miles are posted to a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership only as computed by the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter's compensation rule for a controllable disruption, to the membership named on the disrupted ticket, and in exactly that number of miles. A support agent never grants discretionary miles outside that rule. A request for goodwill miles for a reason no rule covers is transferred to a human representative.

**Bonus miles.** Bonus miles are posted only for a choice-benefit selection or a published promotion, recorded with its ground of bonus.

**Status and effect.** Goodwill and bonus credits post to a membership whose status is enrolled, active or dormant, but they never count as qualifying activity and never earn qualifying dollars.

| Request | Posted |
|---|---|
| Goodwill for a controllable disruption, as the compensation rule computes it, to the membership on the disrupted ticket | Yes, exactly the computed miles |
| Discretionary goodwill outside that rule | No; a reason no rule covers goes to a human representative |
| Bonus for a choice-benefit selection or a published promotion | Yes, with its ground recorded |
| Any credit to a closed membership | No |
